comments.comment: Static configuration recovery with read-only public-chain verification, 2026-10-25 UTC. SHA-256 verified; 17,079-byte community JavaScript sample. The source base64-decodes a Base contract address, 0x623f65e5945c0fecf8f68ff9d98ce56fece6bc6a, and uses selector 0x3bc5de30 in eth_call. Two independent configured public RPCs, mainnet.base.org and base-rpc.publicnode.com, returned matching ABI strings. Decoding the ABI string to hexadecimal ciphertext and authenticating AES-GCM with the sample-embedded key (12-byte nonce, 128-bit tag) independently yielded https://api-76820da3.lisomi-c06.workers.dev from both providers. Key and permit values are deliberately omitted. This is a time-specific recovered backend, not a verified live session; neither the backend nor a returned payload was fetched. The client encrypts action get_bundle/get_resource/fp requests, injects returned execute entries through Blob script URLs, and caches resource text in IndexedDB. It also fingerprints browser/GPU/wallet-provider properties and stops for several automation and wallet-provider checks. These establish loader and anti-analysis capabilities, not the behavior of the absent remotely supplied bundle. Do not infer a specific stealer/drainer family or treat the public RPC services as malicious infrastructure. Held pending second-stage or independent malicious-context confirmation. No JavaScript execution, wallet interaction, transaction signing or backend contact.
